current_status: Gordon accepted delivery of the existing native implementation to main on 2026-09-10 with known limitations. Rounds 1 and 2 remain failed; twenty-one recordings are development data and no replacement candidate passed the accuracy gates. Delivery acceptance does not claim high accuracy or production readiness.
